## 更新内容

- **x265 发布分离**：推荐的 4.3（8/10 位 multilib）改为从 [x265 专用仓库](https://github.com/frankie1024/x265-windows-builds/releases/tag/4.3-multilib.1)下载，保持原有已验证的二进制和 SHA256；对应源码和许可证一并由该仓库提供。FlowEncode 后续发布不再重复附带 x265，3.0.0 旧附件保留兼容。
- **视觉更新**。
- **测试稳定性**：取消测试明确验证子进程已退出，并兼容 Windows 短暂保留的可执行文件锁，避免临时目录清理误报。

提供 Windows x64 安装包、便携 ZIP 和 SHA256 校验文件。

## Update Notes

- **Separate x265 releases**: the recommended 4.3 8/10-bit multilib package now comes from the [dedicated x265 repository](https://github.com/frankie1024/x265-windows-builds/releases/tag/4.3-multilib.1), preserving the verified binary and SHA256. Matching source and licenses are published there. Future FlowEncode releases no longer duplicate x265 assets; existing 3.0.0 assets remain available for compatibility.
- **Visual update**.
- **Test reliability**: cancellation tests explicitly verify child process exit and tolerate brief Windows executable locks during temporary-directory cleanup.

Windows x64 installer, portable ZIP and SHA256 checksums are provided.
